questions.question: What does a trigger decide?
questions.explanation: Trigger semantics are separate from loop completion.

questions.question: What does the evaluator own?
questions.explanation: The evaluator decides whether evidence meets the goal.

questions.question: Why record every loop round?
questions.explanation: Round receipts make the loop replayable and reviewable.

questions.question: Which task fits a goal loop best?
options: A feature with a verifiable acceptance command
questions.explanation: Goal loops need a machine-checkable finish line.

questions.question: What should manual versus automated comparisons measure?
questions.explanation: Reliability improvement needs evidence beyond speed.
